system.description: As a Boost to an attack with a divine weapon, you may reduce your to-hit by X to increase damage if you successfully hit by 2X (where X is any number up to your Proficiency). [3] Greater Elemental Weapon: (Prerequisite: Fate 4). Choose the Boon that matches the elemental damage type dealt by your divine weapon: Vampiric WeaponA: (Prerequisite: Rot Elemental Weapon). Once per quick rest you attempt to steal the life of a target. Choose one target. They make a Fate Check. If they fail, reduce their HP by XD6 and gain temporary HP equal to half the damage dealt (where X is half your Proficiency, rounded up). Crystaline WeaponF: (Prerequisite: Salt Elemental Weapon). Once per quick rest your weapon glows. As long as you maintain Focus, all enemies within 5Xft of you (where X is half your Proficiency, rounded up) treat the area as Bright. Scorching WeaponF: (Prerequisite: Fire Elemental Weapon). As long as you maintain Focus, whenever you make a attack and successfully hit a target, deal fire damage equal to your Power to all additional enemies within 5ft of that target. You may use this once per quick rest. Spring WeaponR: (Prerequisite: Water Elemental Weapon). Once per quick rest as a Reaction to a Wounded ally beginning their turn, you may exhaust any number of unused reactions. They gain 1AP per reaction you exhaust, to a maximum of their maximum unwounded AP. Breezy WeaponB: (Prerequisite: Air Elemental Weapon). Once per quick rest as a Boost to the Kick action, you may make the Kick action against a creature within 60ft of you instead of 5ft, and push them in any direction. Stone WeaponR: (Prerequisite: Earth Elemental Weapon). Once per quick rest as a reaction to an enemy within 30ft of you moving, you may use a reaction to cause them to treat terrain as difficult for that Move action. The Hulinari Warrior T he low rumble of an approaching stampede, the roar of a massive bear crushing against the trees, or the fluttering of a thousand butterfly wings. The Hulinari is the force of a species of animal brought fully to battle, and they reflect that animal in their ferocity as well as their natural inclination for savage combat. The Hulinari is at its best in combat against multiple enemies. Reveling in the odds, Hulinari often see their purpose to take down the human world–and what better way to do that than slashing them to pieces five at a time? Antlers, Claws, and TalonsP: When you make an unarmed attack in Beast form, change the damage dice from 1D4 to 1D8. Basic Combat ProwessP: Gain ten combat skill points to spend immediately. [Level 3] Bestial RespectF: Choose one beast within 30ft of you (with CR less than or equal to half your Proficiency, rounded up) to roll a Fate Check. If they fail, they become your ally until you break Focus. Once per turn they may use a action to roll a Fate check against this effect, ending Bestial Respect on a success. Once a creature succeeds against Bestial Respect, they may not be affected by it again until after a quick rest. [Level 4] Lore IncreaseP: Gain one Lore Increase [L] to spend on Lore abilities.
